name: LOCYFENS
summary: Marketplace-only budget filament brand selling silk PLA, including co-extruded dual- and tri-colour and gradient variants, on 1.75 mm 1 kg spools. A US trademark was filed in April 2022; the owner and country are unconfirmed.

China origin is likely given the marketplace-only pattern but unverified, so headquarters is omitted. No relationships found. SpoolmanDB PR #396 has 1 entry. Next step: read the trademark record for the owner name.
